title: Here Comes The Trouble-Making Witch
overview: An adventure begins! Chacha and the gang are introduced and she gets to transform for the first time into Magical Princess Holyup. MORE DETAILS Dorothy gets very angry when she receives a mirror tells her that she's the most beautiful magician around, but that the best magician is Seravi, not her. She gets EVEN more when Seravi's image in the mirror starts teasing her. Then Dorothy's own image forms into the mirror, and hypnotizes the real Dorothy, making her VERY MAD at Seravi. She ends up creating a dragon, which is what Cha-Cha defeated with Holy up.

title: The Rival Is The Black Riding Hood
overview: On the first day of school, Chacha meets new friends and fights a possessed Teacher Rascal.

title: Selfish Mermaid Marine
overview: On a school beach field trip, the Cha-Cha, Riiya, and Shiine meets Marin. Cha cha Holyup fights George the green sea creature.

title: The Ultimate Three Little Piglet Attack
overview: Everyone falls in love with Ma-rin, when she tried to use a potion to make Riiya fall in love with her.   And 3 little pigs INVADE Cha-cha's school, the Urara Magic School.

title: Date With Que-chan
overview: Rascal-sensei has taken his pupils to a forest near a river. Cha-cha, Riiya, and Shiine face a vampire named Kyuula. The vampire thinks he is SO handsome.

title: Babies Can't Use Magic
overview: Cha-Cha, Riiya, and Shiine turn into babies when magicians Ranran and Kankan cast a spell on them.

title: Snow Explosion! The Teacher Is A Snow Woman
overview: When Rascal- sensei went to Urara Magic School on a bike a mole, in Daimaou's service, dug a large hole and he gets into an accident. So the Banana class gets a subsitute, her name is Oyuki. Teacher Oyuki is gentle and quiet but is very high-strung. A little jab, poke would make her panick and break down. This is special because when she panicks, snow comes out!

title: My Cake Is The Best
overview: When Riiya's grandpa visits the Urara Magic school they have a  food shortage at the Urara Magic School. The bad guy in this episode is a strange sorceress who cooks.

title: Go Nyandaber Z
overview: There is a Girls' Dolls Festival and Cha Cha wanted to celebrate, but since Seravi forgets it since he is a boy he gives her an ancient fighter doll instead of a girl's doll when Cha Cha asks for a doll. When she finds out from Shiine, Riiya, and Doroty that the doll is not a girl's doll she gets upset and runs away. Shiine and Riiya follows her. Then the trio meets a genius inventor Mikaneko and his infamous Nyandabar Z.

title: Que-chan Strikes Back!
overview: Kyuula, the vampire is back for REVENGE.

title: Orin-chan's First Love
overview: In this episode they met Orin, who is a shy ninja. Also an evil sword starts chaos at the Urara Magic School.

title: Do your best house sitting
overview: This episode is sorta like the Red Riding Hood story, with the fox. Cha Cha was told to look after the house because Seravi had gone to a 5th anniversary sale with Dorothy. When she is alone a fox tries to get rid of Cha-Cha.

title: The evil king is angry
overview:
This episode is just a bunch flash-backs when Seravi realizes someone bad is going after Cha-Cha.   HERE ARE THE FLASHBACKS   1. Chacha, Riiya and Shiine are introduced to their Banana-gumi classmates. Chacha creates a big bull [episode 2].

2. Chacha and friends fight over Marin's love, due to Yakko-chan's love potion. Chacha creates three powerful pigs to get rid of Riiya [episode 4].

3.Chacha, Shiine, Riiya and Marin fight against Kyuu-chan. The magical princess defeats him [episode 5].

4.Chacha and her classmates are trapped into Oyuki-sensei's snowy dreams, and must fight against a mole sent by Sorges [episode 7].

5.Chacha, Riiya and Shiine have been trapped by a cooking sorceress, that magical princess defeats. [episode 8]

title: Born! Franken-chan
overview: Chacha gets to play mother when a very large egg chases her home and hatches into a humongous baby.

title: It came out! Umibozu's little sister
overview:
Rascal-sensei and his pupils spend the day at the beach. Some local people tell Rascal that there are dreadful jellyfishes in the sea, and Rascal goes to rescue Riiya and Shiine, who were attacked by some jellyfishes. Chacha's friends have been badly hurt and need a special flower to recover. Chacha, Rascal, Marin, and Orin go to find some, but the only shore where the flowers can be found is guarded by Umibouzu's sister Umibouko.

Recognizing Marin, the girl who dumped her big brother [episode 3], Umibouko attacks them, blocking the way to the cavern where the flowers grow. Umibouko is too strong for the girls, but Umibouzu shows up and asks his sister to let Chacha and Marin go. Meanwhile, the jellyfishes unite to form a giant monster.

title: Zombie warning! Urara School
overview: An Evil cupid makes a deal with Shiine to get Cha Cha to like him. However, it seems impossible for cupid to shoot arrows and ACTUALLY HIT Cha CHa SO he keeps on switching on bodies.

title: The fear! Dorothy's little sister?
overview: Dorothy is begged to prepare dinner for Chacha, Riiya, and Shiine. They all go to a grocery store where Dorothy meets her younger sister Doris. Doris disguises herself as Dorothy and traps Dorothy somewhere when they are eating dinner. However, they figure out it isn't Dorothy because of the way she was acting. At the end Cha Cha uses holy up on Doris's Guard.

title: Phantom theif Nezumi Kid's challenge
overview: Nezumi Kid stole the school stamp and it's up to the gang to recover it or else they cannot graduate.

title: Lots of danger outdoor bath
overview: The search for the school stamp brings them to a hot spring where the trio gets to relax for a while and battles Beppu all at the same time.

title: Surprise. The first sacrifice experience
overview: The kids finds themselves in a deserted village and fight an eight-headed monster to recover the lost school stamp.

title: Fight! Graduation exam
overview: With the stamp recovered, Chacha and the others have to pass the final exam.

title: I am the lengedary Princess?
overview: The kids graduated at last! Then Yakko and Chacha play on a quiz game. Meanwhile, Daimaou learns that Access is returning and ""fires"" Sorges. He crashes on the gang's game and reveals something astounding--Chacha is the real princess .

title: Why Why! Arrow defeated
overview: While Seravi tells the story of Daimaou's return, Shiine falls into a spell and becomes bad. Holyup meets Access for the first time and nearly lost. Seravi tells Chacha to find the Phoenix Sword.

title: Move move, Love's obstruction
overview: While Chacha researches for the Phoenix Bird, Marin and Yakko remembers the past episodes.

title: Fire place's Cha Cha power
overview: The trio search for the phoenix bird in a flammable forest.

title: Welcome! To the town of Phoenix
This is the rumored Phoenix sword
Mirror of Truth is a liar!
Cross the bridge of hot friendship!
The big battle of Love, Courage and Hope
Escape! Escape! Big failure
overview: The three, now living in the palace are a bit uncomfortable, tries to escape from the palace wizard, Daza. Instead, they create trouble.

title: I became number one in the world!
overview: Seravi, notices that Chacha isn't practicing her magic, so challanges her for a magical tournament for the title of the World's Greatest Magician. Guess who's the winner?

title: So many challengers
overview: Since Chacha is the new World's Greatest Magician, everybody challanges her, including her own friends and classmates.

title: Don't forget the sign of the king
overview: When Shiine senses that his father, who is searching for the King's Royal Seal, the Sacred Bird, is in trouble, the three goes to help him.

title: Skate towards number one in the world
overview:
At an ice skating race with school friends, Chacha gets to test her newly-acquired magical gadgets.

There is an ice skating race at school. However, Cha Cha, Riiya, Shiine can't skate at all so they come up with a weird way to skate together. But will they win the race?

title: Elizabeth SOS!
overview: Seravi his dear Elizabeth to Chacha when he goes to his Reunion for school. But doll gets damaged, so the kids rushes it to a toymaker named Gepetto.

title: A very small love story
overview: A very tiny magician, Myran, challanges Chacha for the title of World's Greatest Magician. So Myran makes everybody ill and Chacha has to defeat her or else everybody will be turned to stone.

title: Like like Yakko-chan!
overview: Yakko have a secret admirer, Pickle/Kyle! Yakko declares that he have to get the title first before he can even have a chance for her. But how can he defeat Seravi who regained the title?

title: Young Seravi's Adventure
overview: The trio accidentally goes back to the past through a magic mirror; where they meet the young Dorothy and Seravi.

title: Scoop! The secret of pink
overview: The three with the young Seravi rescues the young Dorothy from Pikapon. Plus you find out why Dorothy has pink hair.

title: Move move nininsankyaku
overview: Unfortunately, Chacha gets to pair with Teacher Barabaraman (who grows thorns all over his body when he gets too excited or happy) on a three-legged race. Luckily, Seravi fixed a potion for the thorny teacher. But there's a catch with the potion, how long will the potion last?

title: Butouha Sensei Maya-chan
overview: The kids have to pass the exam that will move them to the next grade level. But first they have to pass Teacher Maya's tough test.

title: Fear! Friday of 12th
overview: On an excursion to a camp, the girls are chased off by a madman named Jason.

title: Umibouko! First Love Big Battle
overview: Marin gets to become the Queen of the Sea! She wants Riiya to come to the ceremony

title: Story of Yakko-chan's First Love
overview: Seravi asks Yakko to fetch him some herbs for his cold. Of course, Yakko is very much willing to obey with the three tagging along. As they look for the herbs, Yakko tells the story on how she meets her  Seravi while actually also telling how she met Cha Cha, Shiine, and Riiya.

title: Return of Tono
overview: Pikapon returns to get his revenge on Seravi! It's up to the three to take care of Pikapon once and for all.

title: Shiine-chan's ultimate failure
overview: It's going to be Cha Cha's birthday tomorrow but poor Shiine-chan loses his money and Riiya doesn't have money either.

title: The secret of Dorothy's castle
overview: The kids accidentally shrink Seravi and Riiya. They have to get some herbs from Dorothy's castle for the potion to get them to normal. A hard thing to do with Dorothy and Seravi being enemies...or are they really enemies?
